data.name: Aurora
data.gender_notes: Aurora is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin aurora, 'dawn'. Its root is Latin aurora. A classical name later used by Christians. Aurora is a Latin name meaning “Dawn”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aurora expresses “Dawn”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aurora total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
